requirements.method: drawn from fixtures/demo-ack/session.json by test/screen.mjs, never captured from a screen, so no menu bar, account name, window title, other session name or home path was ever in the image to crop
redactionCheck: the shipped bytes must equal the bytes the fixture draws, and the drawing is deterministic: stored deflate blocks, no timestamp, no zlib version dependency
the pixels are read back to text and the text is scanned by the same detectors as the source in test/pack.test.mjs
the recovered text is redrawn and every pixel compared, so a mark the text does not account for is refused
the chunk list must be exactly IHDR, PLTE, IDAT, IEND, so there is no tEXt, iTXt, zTXt, eXIf or tIME to strip
the sha-256 of the file is pinned in test/pack.test.mjs and every other image is still refused by name and by content
limits: the reader matches cells against the font in test/screen.mjs; it is a complete account of a picture this repository drew, not general purpose OCR of an arbitrary image
